dialogs.about: 며느리와 함께 요양원 봉사 이야기를 나눠요

lines.en: Good morning. I went to the nursing home yesterday.
Really, Mother? What did you do there?
I was a helper in the kitchen all day.
That is very kind of you, Mother.
The old people there need our kindness.
Can I assist you there next time?
Of course. They will be happy to meet you.
I want to donate some warm blankets too.
Thank you. Will you come with me on Saturday?
Yes, Mother. I will bring the blankets then.

dialogs.about: 동네 자선 모금 자리에서 도우미와 이야기해요

lines.en: Hello, Ma'am. Welcome to our charity table.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 어르신. 저희 자선 모금 자리에 오신 걸 환영해요.

lines.en: Thank you. What do you do here?
We give warm coats to homeless people.
lines.ko: 집 없는 분들께 따뜻한 외투를 드려요.

lines.en: I brought two warm coats this morning.
lines.ko: 오늘 아침에 따뜻한 외투 두 벌을 가져왔어요.

lines.en: Thank you. Your kindness is a great gift.
Can I contribute some money too?
Of course. It will help the orphan children.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 고아 아이들에게 도움이 될 거예요.

lines.en: Will you send the coats this week?
Yes. We will deliver them on Friday.
Good. I will assist you again next month.
